name: Tiny Music Player
tagline: A tiny music player that just works, even on old phones
description:
Tiny Music Player is a minimal, notification-based audio player that weighs in at under 20KB. It plays the music files on your device through a simple notification, with no bloated interface to load up first.

It is built to run on almost anything, from Android 1.0 up, and respects your privacy by not collecting any data.
